name: Reach to a nearby target
short_description: Move one hand to a nearby target and return it under control.
self_assessment: I can reach a nearby target and return my hand without help.
description: Move one hand to a nearby target and return it under control. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Reach to a cup on a stable surface

builds_on.note: Written movement cues can support independent practice.
